answer: Make splitting pointless. Grading seats are drawn in proportion to tokens locked, and a lock thaws like a glacier: 30 epochs to withdraw. 1,000 tokens give the same odds held by one ID or spread as 10 across 100 clones, so fakes win nothing extra. But each ID pays a flat 1-token upkeep per epoch to keep its berth at the wharf, so 100 clones burn 100 tokens an epoch for zero gain; every added clone is a ripple of pure cost. Fee and lock length are my assumptions.
